tagline: Build original worlds. Keep every piece.

examples.prompt: Build a cozy harbor village with a broad walking quay, a lighthouse and colorful workshops. Keep the buildings and boats separate so I can reuse them in my game; give me a GLB asset kit and an offline walkthrough.
examples.caption: Author an editable environment, walk it and keep named 3D assets

examples.prompt: Block out a civic arts courtyard with a sheltered gallery, water garden, reading canopy and sculpture. Let me move each structure and export the masses in meters for a 3D design tool.
examples.caption: Revise real geometry and physical scale; export independent building masses

examples.prompt: Create a modular dungeon kit with a branching hall, an amber altar and an east treasury. Widen the west entrance while keeping my approved east wing unchanged, and export the modules.
examples.caption: Preserve approved work while revising a reusable voxel kit
